#Base de datos

#Importar base de datos


```{r}
library(googlesheets4)
library(tidyverse)

url <-"https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1pjM8GMqfhJo9nVudwB1-m-Yz4_wFgYMz_o8wpjlM0f8/edit?gid=814885860#gid=814885860"

gs <- url %>% as_sheets_id()

fb <- gs %>%
  range_read("fb") %>%
  mutate(across(1:bloque, ~as factor(.))

str(fb)
```

# ANOVA

$$hi = \mu + trt + bloque + e$$ 

```{r}
md <- aov(nmg ~ bloque + trt,data = fb)
anova(md)
```
# COMPARACIÓN DE MEDIAS 

```{r}
library(emmeans)
library(multcomp)
library(multcompView)

emm_int <- emmeans(md, ~ trt )

cld_int <- cld(
  emm_int,
  adjust = "tukey",
  Letters = letters,
  alpha = 0.05
) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    .group = stringr::str_trim(.group)   # limpia espacios en las letras
  )
library(knitr)
cld_trt %>% kable()
```

#GRÁFICO

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# 📊 Calcular media general
media_general <- mean(cld_int$emmean, na.rm = TRUE)

# 🎨 Crear gráfico tipo "cuadrados con error" y letras Tukey
ggplot(cld_int, aes(x = trt, y = emmean, fill = .group)) +
  geom_point(shape = 22, size = 5, color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL),
                width = 0.15, color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = media_general, linetype = "solid", color = "gray40") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", emmean)),
            vjust = -1.2, size = 3.8, color = "black") +
  labs(
    x = "Tratamiento",
    y = "Número de macollos (media ± IC95%)",
    title = "Comparación de medias ajustadas por tratamiento (Tukey)"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("a" = "gold", "b" = "gray60", "c" = "red")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold")
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(min(cld_int$lower.CL) - 0.2, max(cld_int$upper.CL) + 0.3))

```


```{r}
md <- aov(npg ~ bloque + trt,data = fb)
anova(md)
```


```{r}
library(emmeans)
library(multcomp)
library(multcompView)

emm_int <- emmeans(md, ~ trt )

cld_int <- cld(
  emm_int,
  adjust = "tukey",
  Letters = letters,
  alpha = 0.05
) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    .group = stringr::str_trim(.group)   # limpia espacios en las letras
  )
library(knitr)
cld_int %>% kable()
```



```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# 📊 Calcular media general
media_general <- mean(cld_int$emmean, na.rm = TRUE)

# 🎨 Crear gráfico tipo "cuadrados con error" y letras Tukey
ggplot(cld_int, aes(x = trt, y = emmean, fill = .group)) +
  # Cuadrados rellenos
  geom_point(
    shape = 22,      # cuadrado
    size = 5,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  # Barras de error
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL),
    width = 0.15,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  # Línea horizontal del promedio general
  geom_hline(yintercept = media_general, linetype = "solid", color = "gray40") +
  # Texto de las medias sobre cada punto
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", emmean)),
    vjust = -1.2,
    size = 3.8,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  # Etiquetas y título
  labs(
    x = "Tratamiento",
    y = "NPG (media marginal ± IC95%)",
    title = "Comparación de medias ajustadas de tratamientos para NPG (Tukey)"
  ) +
  # Colores personalizados (puedes ajustar según tus letras Tukey)
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("a" = "gold", "b" = "gray60", "c" = "red")) +
  # Tema limpio
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold")
  ) +
  # Ajuste de límites del eje Y
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(min(cld_int$lower.CL) - 0.3, max(cld_int$upper.CL) + 0.5))


```
